name: spring-jdbc
description: Spring Framework 7.0.9 TransactionTemplate on DataSourceTransactionManager, with JdbcTemplate writes. Category C faults are a client-side injection in this process, fired once, before pgjdbc sends. Native mode uses DriverManagerDataSource and no pool. TX-03 runs only in the pooled mode (HikariCP 7.1.0, maximumPoolSize 1).

modes.description: DriverManagerDataSource. A connection is opened for the transaction and closed when Spring releases it. No pool. The outer TransactionTemplate uses the default PROPAGATION_REQUIRED. A nested TransactionTemplate uses PROPAGATION_NESTED. TX-03 is not run in this mode (not-applicable-by-design). On this server, DataSourceUtils.releaseConnection closed a connection whose autocommit was false, and that backend was gone from pg_stat_activity. DataSourceTransactionManager.doCleanupAfterCompletion unbinds the holder and then calls releaseConnection, which closes the connection because it is no longer bound. The next TransactionTemplate ran on a different backend. This DataSource cannot hand a transactionally active connection to later work.

HikariCP 7.1.0 with maximumPoolSize 1. No other pool setting is changed. Between the two units the connection is released through Spring's normal path. The pool is not closed, the connection is not evicted, and no validation query is issued between them. TX-03 runs only in this mode.
